title: tooling(pm): `qa-run-publish.mjs` — post a QA run's outbox (record, comments, defect cards, close-outs, anchor summary) in order, with placeholder numbers filled, as ONE bare command
body:
Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task** — in the 18.2.0 wave-2 session (2026-10-27) the PM proposed, for the cloud runners whose GitHub writes were refused, a script that posts a QA run's whole outbox as one bare command; the maintainer answered, verbatim: 「同意,写入权限按你的方案做」.
Business reason: in the 18.2.0 wave-2 sweep 4 of 5 cloud runners could not post their own records. The PM session posted them by hand: extracting each file from the runner's transcript, splitting card titles from bodies, replacing `#RECORD` / `#RUNREC` / `#P1` / `#CARD-*` placeholders with the numbers each create returned, spacing `{{ }}` out of bodies `post-stamped.mjs` would refuse, moving an over-cap record section into a comment, appending footers — several dozen hand steps across the 4 runners, four of them redone after a write door refused the first try, and one record title nearly posted with the previous wave's counts. One door that does all of it removes the hand work and gives the write a single shape the repo's `.claude/settings.json` allow rules match.
Reader: the `domain:skills` lane (`scripts/pm/**`, the PM tooling) — new file `scripts/pm/qa-run-publish.mjs` with a `--self-test`, wired where the other `scripts/pm/` self-tests are wired.
Dedupe (open AND closed): searched "qa run publish outbox post record comments cards placeholder" — no tool exists; the doors it composes are `issue-create.mjs`, `post-stamped.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`, `write-pace.mjs`.

## What the door does

- Input: `--outbox DIR` holding a `manifest.json` (ordered steps: `{ kind: record|comment|card|close, target, titleFile, bodyFile, labels, produces: "RECORD"|"P1"|… }`) and the files it names; `--repo owner/name`; `--dry-run`.
- Order and fill: runs the steps in order; each `card`/`record` step's returned number fills its `produces` token (`#RECORD`, `#CARD-X`, …) in every later file before that file is posted; a token left unfilled at post time is a refusal, not a post.
- Through the existing doors only: `write-pace.mjs --announce-batch N` once for the batch, then `issue-create.mjs` / `post-stamped.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` per step — never a bare REST write, never MCP.
- Resumable and idempotent: a `state.json` in the outbox records each step's result (number, comment id); a re-run skips done steps and resumes at the first undone one.
- Pre-flight before any write: body size against the relay cap (a body over it is refused with the byte count and the split the manifest should make, never trimmed silently); `{{`/`}}` not meant as stamp tokens; angle-bracket placeholders the write layer would strip; the `qa-run` title grammar (RUNNER.md "The record title"), including that the counts in the title equal the per-item verdict table in the body when the body carries one.
- Footer: appends the attribution footer to any body that lacks it.

## Done when

- `node scripts/pm/qa-run-publish.mjs --self-test` covers: order + token fill, refusal on an unfilled token, resume after a mid-batch failure (no duplicate card), the size pre-flight, the title-count check, dry-run writes nothing.
- The self-test is wired into the gate that runs the other `scripts/pm/` self-tests.
- One line in `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §4 names the door — that line rides the PM's Tier S PR for the write-shape rule, not this card.
